content: window.self !== window.top is the standard, cross-origin-safe way to detect whether a content script is running in a subframe -- this comparison itself never throws even cross-origin (only subsequent property access like window.top.location would throw a SecurityError under a different origin). This is the correct primitive for D-10's per-request frame/origin recomputation, combined with the frame's own document.location.origin and the background's independent sender.frameId/tab.id check (not a page-supplied value).
